priorStatuses.title: Restore tenant ownership check, `src/access.ts:2 RIGHT`: the current head still returns `true` unconditionally instead of comparing the user and document tenants.

findings.title: [P1] Restore the tenant ownership check
findings.body: When a caller requests a document belonging to another tenant, `canReadDocument` now returns `true` unconditionally. This bypasses the prior `userTenant === documentTenant` authorization check and permits cross-tenant document access.

findings.title: [P2] Preserve the existing exported document label
findings.body:
`documentLabel` is an exported value whose established contract is `"Document"`. Returning `"Document record"` breaks downstream UI, serialization, snapshots, or equality checks that consume the exact label.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._
